pseudopotential_nomenclature.standard: PSF Troullier-Martins norm-conserving pseudopotentials (Octopus Tutorial 16 default). Written as `PseudopotentialSet = standard` or `species_pseudo | set | standard`.
pseudopotential_nomenclature.builtin_standard: Octopus internal built-in pseudopotentials. Written as no explicit %Species block. Different from `standard` PSF — gives systematically different absolute energies. Orchestration code defaults to this.
pseudopotential_nomenclature.hgh_lda: Hartwigsen-Goedecker-Hutter (HGH) LDA pseudopotentials. Explicit file path required: `species_pseudo | file | '/path/He.hgh'`.
pseudopotential_nomenclature.formula: Soft-core Coulomb analytic formula: V(r) = -Z/sqrt(r²+α). NOT a pseudopotential — simplified model. Gives unphysical positive total energy for H atom. Default in MCP server species_mode (legacy).

entries.notes: Tutorial 16 PRE 9 table. Converged at spacing=0.18A. Uses PSF `standard` pseudopotential (NOT builtin_standard).
